title.narrative: NAMA - Low Carbon Coffee - Costa Rica

description.narrative: Costa Rica’s project ‘Low Carbon Coffee’ aimed at a climate-friendly transformation of the entire value chain of one of the most important economic sectors. It provided technical and policy advice to change production and processing practices in this sector which was the source of 10% of the country’s greenhouse gas emissions. Furthermore, the project incentivised private sector investments by providing grants, loans, and guarantees of more than EUR 5M for coffee farmers and millers to introduce greenhouse gas-efficient fertiliser and milling technologies. The project contributed to the empowerment of farmers and millers to develop sustainable livelihoods and directly impacted 9,851 beneficiaries. Total emission reductions of 107,451 t CO2e were directly or indirectly attributable to the project.
